mapper.select: SELECT ei.id AS entId, ei.ent_name AS entName, COUNT(DISTINCT aim.id) AS alarmCount, COUNT(DISTINCT rr.id) AS violationCount, 0 AS deviceNormalRate, 0 AS rectifyFinishRate, 1 AS `rank` FROM ai_alert_message aim INNER JOIN rectify_review rr ON aim.rectify_review_id = rr.id INNER JOIN enterprise_info ei ON rr.ent_id = ei.id WHERE aim.deleted = 0 AND rr.deleted = 0 AND ei.deleted = 0 GROUP BY ei.id, ei.ent_name ORDER BY violationCount DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ei.id) FROM ai_alert_message aim INNER JOIN rectify_review rr ON aim.rectify_review_id = rr.id INNER JOIN enterprise_info ei ON rr.ent_id = ei.id WHERE aim.deleted = 0 AND rr.deleted = 0 AND ei.deleted = 0
